title: Gene network organization, mutation and selection collectively drive developmental pattern evolvability and predictability
one_liner_zh: 该文研究基因调控网络驱动发育模式演化的进化动力学，聚焦突变与网络组织，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: A hallmark of development is the generation of spatial patterns driven by morphogen gradients and Gene Regulatory Networks (GRNs). Although the mechanistic basis by which GRNs orchestrate cellular responses and tissue patterning during development is well understood, their evolutionary dynamics remain less clear. Still, utations in regulatory elements that govern GRN-driven patterning are a key mechanism for patterning evolution. In this study, we use the de novo evolution of a stripe phenotype as a model framework to investigate the evolutionary dynamics associated with the emergence of new spatial gene expression boundaries and the adjustment of existing boundaries. To probe general principles of GRN-driven pattern evolution we introduce a new high-throughput theoretical framework that rapidly produces a comprehensive dataset of evolutionary trajectories. We leverage this large dataset to investigate the types of mutations that drive different phenotypic shifts in spatial patterning. Our findings suggest that the order in which mutations in gene-gene interactions appear, and the specific combination of gene-gene interactions that mutate together determine the evolvability of novel spatial gene expression patterns. We interpret our results in the context of epistatic effects that naturally arise in networks of interconnected genes, and show how contingencies and constraints emerge in our system. Our results elucidate the interplay between mutation and gene network organization, revealing how historical contingencies arise and impact the evolvability of GRNs and the predictability of their evolutionary outcomes.
abstract_zh: 发育的一个标志性特征是由形态发生素梯度和基因调控网络（Gene Regulatory Networks, GRNs）驱动的空间模式生成。尽管GRNs在发育过程中协调细胞反应和组织模式的机制基础已被充分理解，但其进化动态仍不太清楚。然而，调控GRN驱动模式的调控元件中的突变是模式进化的关键机制。在本研究中，我们利用条纹表型的从头进化为模型框架，探讨与新空间基因表达边界出现及现有边界调整相关的进化动态。为了探究GRN驱动模式进化的普遍原理，我们引入了一个新的高通量理论框架，该框架能快速生成全面的进化轨迹数据集。我们利用这一大型数据集来研究驱动空间模式中不同表型变化的突变类型。我们的发现表明，基因-基因相互作用中突变出现的顺序，以及共同突变的基因-基因相互作用的特定组合，决定了新空间基因表达模式的可进化性。我们在相互连接基因网络中自然产生的上位效应背景下解释我们的结果，并展示在我们的系统中偶然性和约束是如何出现的。我们的结果阐明了突变与基因网络组织之间的相互作用，揭示了历史偶然性如何产生并影响GRNs的可进化性及其进化结果的可预测性。
